Underlined heading style produces setext-style headings for h1 and h2

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"heading_style\":\"Underlined\"}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<h1>Main Title</h1>", options)
    println(result)
}
```
